mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_conversation (id, tenant_id, agent_id, user_id, title, conversation_type) values (#{e.id}, #{e.tenantId}, #{e.agentId}, #{e.userId}, #{e.title}, #{e.conversationType})
mapper.update: update ai_agent_conversation set last_message_time = current_timestamp, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0
